entities.name: 4-Propyl-tetrahydropyridine
observations: Decoded reactant: CCCC=C1CCNCC1, a secondary amine whose ring nitrogen acts as the nucleophile.

entities.name: 3-Chloropropyl cyclic carbamate
observations: Decoded reactant: O=C1COc2ccccc2N1CCCCl, containing a terminal 3-chloropropyl electrophile.
The terminal carbon attached to chlorine undergoes SN2 substitution.

entities.name: N-alkylation product
observations: Base-promoted substitution replaces the terminal C–Cl bond with a C–N bond from the tetrahydropyridine nitrogen.

entities.name: Carbonate iodide base conditions
observations: Carbonate salts serve as base and iodide is an additive or halide-exchange promoter; methanol and dichloromethane are likely media or workup components.
Solvent assignment is less certain than the N-alkylation assignment.
